$comment: The two third-party inputs to a Windows bundle, pinned. This file is the answer to 'why not commit the installer': the RECIPE is tracked, the artifacts are not. A rebuild is reproducible because both inputs have a URL and a SHA-256, and the version of each is a decision recorded here rather than in somebody's shell history.

node.why: The runtime the node executes under on Windows. Node 20 LTS matches the minimum the installer enforces (Node.js 20+).

postgresql.why: PostgreSQL 16 for Windows: the same major version the engine matrix proves the node's schema on. Only bin/, lib/ and share/ are staged; the archive's pgAdmin and documentation are dropped.
